verses.original: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל חַנָּה֙ וַתֹּאמַ֔ר עָלַ֤ץ לִבִּי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה רָ֥מָה קַרְנִ֖י בַּֽיהוָ֑ה רָ֤חַב פִּי֙ עַל־ א֣וֹיְבַ֔י כִּ֥י שָׂמַ֖חְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṯ·pal·lêl ḥan·nāh wat·tō·mar ‘ā·laṣ lib·bî Yah·weh rā·māh qar·nî Yah·weh rā·ḥaḇ pî ‘al- ’ō·wy·ḇay kî śā·maḥ·tî bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: At that time Hannah . . . prayed My heart rejoices in the LORD my horn is exalted in the LORD My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies for I rejoice in Your salvation
verses.literalPt: Então, Ana orou e disse: Alegra-se o meu coração em Jeová. Exaltado é o meu poder em Jeová. A minha boca dilata-se sobre os meus inimigos, porque eu me regozijo na tua salvação.

verses.original: אֵין־ קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- qā·ḏō·wōš Yah·weh kî ’ên bil·te·ḵā wə·’ên ṣūr kê·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: There is no one holy like the LORD Indeed there is no one besides You And there is no Rock like our God
verses.literalPt: Ninguém há santo como Jeová; pois não há outro fora de ti, nem há outra rocha como o nosso Deus.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּרְבּ֤וּ תְדַבְּרוּ֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה יֵצֵ֥א עָתָ֖ק מִפִּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל דֵּעוֹת֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא נִתְכְּנ֖וּ עֲלִלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tar·bū ṯə·ḏab·bə·rū gə·ḇō·hāh ḡə·ḇō·hāh yê·ṣê ‘ā·ṯāq mip·pî·ḵem kî ’êl dê·‘ō·wṯ Yah·weh wə·lō niṯ·kə·nū ‘ă·li·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not boast . . . so proudly . . . or let arrogance come from your mouth for the LORD is a God who knows and by Him actions are weighed
verses.literalPt: Não continueis a falar tão orgulhosamente; não saiam da vossa boca palavras arrogantes, porque Jeová é Deus que tudo sabe, e por ele são pesadas as ações.

verses.original: קֶ֥שֶׁת גִּבֹּרִ֖ים חַתִּ֑ים וְנִכְשָׁלִ֖ים אָ֥זְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: qe·šeṯ gib·bō·rîm ḥat·tîm wə·niḵ·šā·lîm ’ā·zə·rū ḥā·yil
verses.literal: The bows of the mighty are broken but the feeble are equipped with strength
verses.literalPt: O arco dos fortes se quebra, e os fracos são cingidos de força.

verses.original: שְׂבֵעִ֤ים בַּלֶּ֙חֶם֙ נִשְׂכָּ֔רוּ וּרְעֵבִ֖ים חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַד־ עֲקָרָה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְרַבַּ֥ת בָּנִ֖ים אֻמְלָֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·ḇê·‘îm bal·le·ḥem niś·kā·rū ū·rə·‘ê·ḇîm ḥā·ḏêl·lū ‘aḏ- ‘ă·qā·rāh yā·lə·ḏāh šiḇ·‘āh wə·rab·baṯ bā·nîm ’um·lā·lāh
verses.literal: The well-fed hire themselves out for food but the starving hunger no more . . . The barren woman gives birth to seven but she who has many sons pines away
verses.literalPt: Os fartos assalariam-se por pão, e os famintos deixam de ter fome. Até a estéril deu à luz sete filhos, e a que teve muitos filhos perde as forças.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה מֵמִ֣ית וּמְחַיֶּ֑ה מוֹרִ֥יד שְׁא֖וֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mê·mîṯ ū·mə·ḥay·yeh mō·w·rîḏ šə·’ō·wl way·yā·‘al
verses.literal: The LORD brings death and gives life He brings down to Sheol and raises up
verses.literalPt: Jeová é o que tira a vida e a dá; faz descer ao Sheol e faz subir.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה מוֹרִ֣ישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁ֑יר מַשְׁפִּ֖יל אַף־ מְרוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mō·w·rîš ū·ma·‘ă·šîr maš·pîl ’ap̄- mə·rō·w·mêm
verses.literal: The LORD sends poverty and wealth He humbles and He exalts
verses.literalPt: Jeová é o que empobrece e dá riquezas; ele abate e também eleva.

verses.original: מֵקִ֨ים מֵעָפָ֜ר דָּ֗ל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת֙ יָרִ֣ים אֶבְי֔וֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב֙ עִם־ נְדִיבִ֔ים וְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד יַנְחִלֵ֑ם כִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ מְצֻ֣קֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וַיָּ֥שֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תֵּבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mê·qîm mê·‘ā·p̄ār dāl mê·’aš·pōṯ yā·rîm ’eḇ·yō·wn lə·hō·wō·šîḇ ‘im- nə·ḏî·ḇîm wə·ḵis·sê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ yan·ḥi·lêm kî Yah·weh mə·ṣu·qê ’e·reṣ way·yā·šeṯ ‘ă·lê·hem tê·ḇêl
verses.literal: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s and upon them He has set the world
verses.literalPt: Levanta do pó ao pobre, do monturo eleva ao necessitado, para os fazer assentar entre os príncipes e para lhes dar por herança um trono de glória; pois de Jeová são as colunas da terra, e sobre elas tem posto o mundo.

verses.original: רַגְלֵ֤י חֲסִידוֹ יִשְׁמֹ֔ר וּרְשָׁעִ֖ים בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יִדָּ֑מּוּ כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א בְכֹ֖חַ יִגְבַּר־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: raḡ·lê ḥă·sī·ḏō yiš·mōr ū·rə·šā·‘îm ba·ḥō·šeḵ yid·dām·mū kî- lō ḇə·ḵō·aḥ yiḡ·bar- ’îš
verses.literal: He guards the steps of His faithful ones but the wicked perish in darkness for by his own strength shall no man prevail
verses.literalPt: Ele guardará os pés dos seus santos; os ímpios, porém, ficarão mudos nas trevas, porque, pela força, não prevalecerá o homem.

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה יֵחַ֣תּוּ מְרִיבוֹ עָלוֹ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יַרְעֵ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה יָדִ֣ין אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִתֶּן־ עֹ֣ז לְמַלְכּ֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖ם קֶ֥רֶן מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yê·ḥat·tū mə·rī·ḇō ʿå̄·lō baš·šā·ma·yim yar·‘êm Yah·weh yā·ḏîn ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ wə·yit·ten- ‘ōz lə·mal·kōw wə·yā·rêm qe·ren mə·šî·ḥōw
verses.literal: Those who oppose the LORD will be shattered He will thunder from heaven against them The LORD will judge the ends of the earth and will give power to His king He will exalt the horn of His anointed
verses.literalPt: Jeová despedaçará os seus inimigos e contra eles trovejará nos céus. Jeová julgará as extremidades da terra; dará força ao seu rei e exaltará o poder do seu ungido.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֶלְקָנָ֛ה הָרָמָ֖תָה עַל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֗עַר הָיָ֤ה מְשָׁרֵת֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י עֵלִ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’el·qā·nāh hā·rā·mā·ṯāh ‘al- bê·ṯōw wə·han·na·‘ar hā·yāh mə·šā·rêṯ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- pə·nê ‘ê·lî hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah . . . but the boy . . . began ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest
verses.literalPt: Então, se retirou Elcana para sua casa, em Ramá. O menino, porém, ficou servindo a Jeová na presença do sacerdote Eli.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י עֵלִ֖י בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיָּ֑עַל לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘ê·lî bə·nê ḇə·lî·yā·‘al lō yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men they had no regard for the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ora, os filhos de Eli eram filhos de Belial; não conheciam a Jeová.

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם כָּל־ אִ֞ישׁ זֹבֵ֣חַ זֶ֗בַח וּבָ֨א נַ֤עַר הַכֹּהֵן֙ כְּבַשֵּׁ֣ל הַבָּשָׂ֔ר וְהַמַּזְלֵ֛ג שְׁלֹ֥שׁ־ הַשִּׁנַּ֖יִם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·paṭ hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- hā·‘ām kāl- ’îš zō·ḇê·aḥ ze·ḇaḥ ū·ḇā na·‘ar hak·kō·hên kə·ḇaš·šêl hab·bā·śār wə·ham·maz·lêḡ šə·lōš- haš·šin·na·yim bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: or for the custom of the priests with the people When any man offered a sacrifice the servant of the priest would come with a three-pronged . . . . . . meat fork while the meat was boiling
verses.literalPt: Este era o costume dos sacerdotes para com o povo: sempre que alguém oferecia um sacrifício, vinha o servo do sacerdote, quando se cozia a carne, tendo na mão o seu garfo de três dentes,

verses.original: וְהִכָּ֨ה בַכִּיּ֜וֹר א֣וֹ בַדּ֗וּד א֤וֹ בַקַּלַּ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַפָּר֔וּר כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲלֶ֣ה הַמַּזְלֵ֔ג יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בּ֑וֹ כָּ֚כָה יַעֲשׂ֣וּ לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kāh ḇak·kî·yō·wr ’ōw ḇad·dūḏ ’ōw ḇaq·qal·la·ḥaṯ ’ōw ḇap·pā·rūr kōl ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·leh ham·maz·lêḡ yiq·qaḥ hak·kō·hên bōw kā·ḵāh ya·‘ă·śū lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl hab·bā·’îm šām bə·ši·lōh
verses.literal: and plunge it into the pan or kettle or cauldron or cooking pot And the priest would claim for himself whatever the meat fork brought up This is how they treated all the Israelites who came . . . to Shiloh
verses.literalPt: e metia-o na panela, ou no tacho, ou no caldeirão, ou na marmita. Tudo o que o garfo trazia para cima, tomava-o o sacerdote para si. Assim faziam em Siló a todos os israelitas que lá chegavam.

verses.original: גַּם֮ בְּטֶרֶם֮ יַקְטִר֣וּן אֶת־ הַחֵלֶב֒ וּבָ֣א׀ נַ֣עַר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַר֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֹּבֵ֔חַ תְּנָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר לִצְל֖וֹת לַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְלֹֽא־ יִקַּ֧ח מִמְּךָ֛ בָּשָׂ֥ר מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל כִּ֥י אִם־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam bə·ṭe·rem yaq·ṭi·rūn ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ū·ḇā na·‘ar hak·kō·hên wə·’ā·mar lā·’îš haz·zō·ḇê·aḥ tə·nāh ḇā·śār liṣ·lō·wṯ lak·kō·hên wə·lō- yiq·qaḥ mim·mə·ḵā bā·śār mə·ḇuš·šāl kî ’im- ḥāy
verses.literal: Even before the fat was burned the servant of the priest would come and say to the man who was sacrificing Give the priest some meat to roast because he will not accept boiled meat from you but only raw
verses.literalPt: Ainda mais: antes que queimassem a gordura, vinha o servo do sacerdote e dizia ao homem que estava oferecendo o sacrifício: Dá carne de assar para o sacerdote, porque ele não receberá de ti carne cozida, mas crua.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הָאִ֗ישׁ קַטֵּ֨ר יַקְטִיר֤וּן כַּיּוֹם֙ הַחֵ֔לֶב וְקַ֨ח־ לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְאָמַ֥ר׀ לוֹ כִּ֚י עַתָּ֣ה תִתֵּ֔ן וְאִם־ לֹ֖א לָקַ֥חְתִּי בְחָזְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hā·’îš qaṭ·ṭêr yaq·ṭî·rūn kay·yō·wm ha·ḥê·leḇ wə·qaḥ- lə·ḵā ka·’ă·šer tə·’aw·weh nap̄·še·ḵā wə·’ā·mar lō kî ‘at·tāh ṯit·tên wə·’im- lō lā·qaḥ·tî ḇə·ḥā·zə·qāh
verses.literal: And if any man said to him The fat must be burned . . . first then you may take . . . whatever you want the servant would reply No you must give it to me right now If you refuse I will take it by force
verses.literalPt: Se lhe respondia o ofertante: Sem dúvida, logo há de ser queimada a gordura; então, tomarás quanto quiseres; replicava-lhe o servo: Não, porém hás de dar-ma agora; se não, tomá-la-ei à força.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י חַטַּ֧את הַנְּעָרִ֛ים גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹ֖ד אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִֽאֲצוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ han·nə·‘ā·rîm gə·ḏō·w·lāh mə·’ōḏ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh kî ni·’ă·ṣū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’êṯ min·ḥaṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus the sin of these young men was severe . . . in the sight of the LORD for they were treating the LORD’s offering with contempt
verses.literalPt: Era muito grande o pecado desses moços diante de Jeová, pois o povo veio a desprezar a oferta de Jeová.

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל מְשָׁרֵ֖ת אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה נַ֕עַר חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mū·’êl mə·šā·rêṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh na·‘ar ḥā·ḡūr ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ bāḏ
verses.literal: Now Samuel was ministering before the LORD a boy wearing a linen ephod
verses.literalPt: Samuel, porém, ministrava diante de Jeová, vestido de um éfode de linho.

verses.original: וּמְעִ֤יל קָטֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֣וֹ אִמּ֔וֹ וְהַעַלְתָ֥ה ל֖וֹ מִיָּמִ֣ים׀ יָמִ֑ימָה בַּֽעֲלוֹתָהּ֙ אֶת־ אִישָׁ֔הּ לִזְבֹּ֖חַ אֶת־ זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·‘îl qā·ṭōn ta·‘ă·śeh- lōw ’im·mōw wə·ha·‘al·ṯāh lōw mî·yā·mîm yā·mî·māh ba·‘ă·lō·w·ṯāh ’eṯ- ’î·šāh liz·bō·aḥ ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Each year . . . his mother would make him a little robe and bring it to him when she went with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice
verses.literalPt: Sua mãe fazia-lhe uma pequena túnica e, de ano em ano, lha trazia, quando subia em companhia de seu marido a oferecer o sacrifício anual.

verses.original: וּבֵרַ֨ךְ עֵלִ֜י אֶת־ אֶלְקָנָ֣ה וְאֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וְאָמַר֙ יָשֵׂם֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ זֶ֙רַע֙ מִן־ הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את תַּ֚חַת הַשְּׁאֵלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖ל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהָלְכ֖וּ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇê·raḵ ‘ê·lî ’eṯ- ’el·qā·nāh wə·’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·’ā·mar yā·śêm Yah·weh lə·ḵā ze·ra‘ min- hā·’iš·šāh haz·zōṯ ta·ḥaṯ haš·šə·’ê·lāh ’ă·šer šā·’al Yah·weh wə·hā·lə·ḵū lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife saying May the LORD give you children by this woman in place of the one she dedicated to the LORD Then they would go home
verses.literalPt: Eli abençoou a Elcana e a sua mulher e disse: Jeová te dê semente desta mulher em lugar da que foi pedida a Jeová. Então, voltaram para sua casa.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פָקַ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ חַנָּ֔ה וַתַּ֛הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־ בָנִ֖ים וּשְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת וַיִּגְדַּ֛ל הַנַּ֥עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל עִם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄ā·qaḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ḥan·nāh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ šə·lō·šāh- ḇā·nîm ū·šə·tê ḇā·nō·wṯ way·yiḡ·dal han·na·‘ar šə·mū·’êl ‘im- Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the LORD attended to Hannah and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Visitou Jeová a Ana, e ela concebeu e deu à luz três filhos e duas filhas. Entretanto, o menino Samuel crescia diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וְעֵלִ֖י זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וְשָׁמַ֗ע אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשׂ֤וּן בָּנָיו֙ לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ יִשְׁכְּבוּן֙ אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים הַצֹּ֣בְא֔וֹת פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·lî zā·qên mə·’ōḏ wə·šā·ma‘ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śūn bā·nāw lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer- yiš·kə·ḇūn ’eṯ- han·nā·šîm haṣ·ṣō·ḇə·’ō·wṯ pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Now Eli was very old and he heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they were sleeping with the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Ora, Eli era muito velho, mas ouvia tudo o que faziam seus filhos a todo o Israel e como se deitavam com as mulheres que ministravam à porta da tenda da revelação.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם לָ֥מָּה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵיכֶ֣ם רָעִ֔ים מֵאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָעָ֥ם אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem lām·māh ṯa·‘ă·śūn kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê·ḵem rā·‘îm mê·’êṯ kāl- hā·‘ām ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Why are you doing these things Eli said to his sons I hear about your wicked deeds from all these people
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes: Por que fazeis tais coisas? De todo este povo eu ouço falar dos vossos maus atos.

verses.original: אַ֖ל בָּנָ֑י כִּ֠י לֽוֹא־ טוֹבָ֤ה הַשְּׁמֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י שֹׁמֵ֔עַ מַעֲבִרִ֖ים עַם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al bā·nāy kî lō·w- ṭō·w·ḇāh haš·šə·mu·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘ ma·‘ă·ḇi·rîm ‘am- Yah·weh
verses.literal: No my sons . . . it is not a good report I hear circulating among the LORD’s people
verses.literalPt: Não, filhos meus; pois não é boa a fama que eu ouço. Estais fazendo transgredir o povo de Jeová.

verses.original: אִם־ יֶחֱטָ֨א אִ֤ישׁ לְאִישׁ֙ וּפִֽלְל֣וֹ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאִ֤ם לַֽיהוָה֙ יֶֽחֱטָא־ אִ֔ישׁ מִ֖י יִתְפַּלֶּל־ ל֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ לְק֣וֹל אֲבִיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֖ה לַהֲמִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ye·ḥĕ·ṭā ’îš lə·’îš ū·p̄il·lōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’im Yah·weh ye·ḥĕ·ṭā- ’îš mî yiṯ·pal·lel- lōw wə·lō yiš·mə·‘ū lə·qō·wl ’ă·ḇî·hem kî- ḥā·p̄êṣ Yah·weh la·hă·mî·ṯām
verses.literal: If a man sins against another man God can intercede for him but if a man sins against the LORD who can intercede for him But they would not listen . . . to their father since the LORD intended to put them to death
verses.literalPt: Se o homem pecar contra outro, Deus o julgará; mas, se um homem pecar contra Jeová, quem intercederá por ele? Todavia, não ouviram a voz de seu pai, porque Jeová os queria matar.

verses.original: וְהַנַּ֣עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל וָט֑וֹב גַּ֚ם עִם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַ֖ם עִם־ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·na·‘ar šə·mū·’êl hō·lêḵ wə·ḡā·ḏêl wā·ṭō·wḇ gam ‘im- Yah·weh wə·ḡam ‘im- ’ă·nā·šîm
verses.literal: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor . . . with the LORD . . . and with man
verses.literalPt: Mas o menino Samuel ia crescendo em estatura e no favor de Jeová bem como dos homens.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אִישׁ־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ עֵלִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲנִגְלֹ֤ה נִגְלֵ֙יתִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְבֵ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’îš- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ‘ê·lî way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hă·niḡ·lōh niḡ·lê·ṯî ’el- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bih·yō·w·ṯām bə·miṣ·ra·yim lə·ḇêṯ par·‘ōh
verses.literal: Then a man of God came to Eli and told him This is what the LORD says Did I not clearly reveal Myself . . . to your father’s house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh’s house
verses.literalPt: Veio um homem de Deus a Eli e disse-lhe: Assim diz Jeová: Não me revelei à casa de teu pai, quando eles estavam no Egito sujeitos à casa de Faraó?

verses.original: וּבָחֹ֣ר אֹ֠תוֹ מִכָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לִי֙ לְכֹהֵ֔ן לַעֲל֣וֹת עַֽל־ מִזְבְּחִ֗י לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֛רֶת לָשֵׂ֥את אֵפ֖וֹד לְפָנָ֑י וָֽאֶתְּנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ אֶת־ כָּל־ אִשֵּׁ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ḥōr ’ō·ṯōw mik·kāl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl lî lə·ḵō·hên la·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘al- miz·bə·ḥî lə·haq·ṭîr qə·ṭō·reṯ lā·śêṯ ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ lə·p̄ā·nāy wā·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- ’iš·šê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And out of all the tribes of Israel I selected your father to be My priest to offer sacrifices on My altar to burn incense and to wear an ephod in My presence I also gave to the house of your father all the food offerings of the Israelites
verses.literalPt: Eu o escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel para ser o meu sacerdote, para subir ao meu altar, para queimar incenso e para trazer um éfode diante de mim; e dei à casa de teu pai todas as ofertas queimadas dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה תִבְעֲט֗וּ בְּזִבְחִי֙ וּבְמִנְחָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי מָע֑וֹן וַתְּכַבֵּ֤ד אֶת־ בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נִּי לְהַבְרִֽיאֲכֶ֗ם מֵרֵאשִׁ֛ית כָּל־ מִנְחַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯiḇ·‘ă·ṭū bə·ziḇ·ḥî ū·ḇə·min·ḥā·ṯî ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî mā·‘ō·wn wat·tə·ḵab·bêḏ ’eṯ- bā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî lə·haḇ·rî·’ă·ḵem mê·rê·šîṯ kāl- min·ḥaṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘am·mî
verses.literal: Why then do you kick at My sacrifice and offering that I have prescribed for My dwelling place You have honored your sons more than Me by fattening yourselves with the best of all the offerings of My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Por que pisastes aos pés os meus sacrifícios e as minhas ofertas que ordenei que se fizessem na minha habitação, e por que honras a teus filhos mais do que a mim, engordando-vos das melhores de todas as ofertas do meu povo de Israel?

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻם־ יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אָמ֣וֹר אָמַ֔רְתִּי בֵּֽיתְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ יִתְהַלְּכ֥וּ לְפָנַ֖י עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְעַתָּ֤ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָה֙ חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י כִּֽי־ מְכַבְּדַ֥י אֲכַבֵּ֖ד וּבֹזַ֥י יֵקָֽלּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mō·wr ’ā·mar·tî bê·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū lə·p̄ā·nay ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·‘at·tāh nə·’um- Yah·weh ḥā·lî·lāh lî kî- mə·ḵab·bə·ḏay ’ă·ḵab·bêḏ ū·ḇō·zay yê·qāl·lū
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD the God of Israel declares I did indeed say that your house and the house of your father would walk before Me forever But now the LORD declares Far be it from Me For I will honor those who honor Me but those who despise Me will be disdained
verses.literalPt: Portanto, diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Eu tinha dito que a tua casa e a casa de teu pai andariam para sempre diante de mim, mas, agora, diz Jeová: Longe de mim tal coisa, porque honrarei aos que me honram, e os que me desprezam serão tidos em pouca conta.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וְגָֽדַעְתִּי֙ אֶת־ זְרֹ֣עֲךָ֔ וְאֶת־ זְרֹ֖עַ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ מִֽהְי֥וֹת זָקֵ֖ן בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm wə·ḡā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- zə·rō·‘ă·ḵā wə·’eṯ- zə·rō·a‘ bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā mih·yō·wṯ zā·qên bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your father’s house so that no one in it will reach old age
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias em que cortarei o teu braço e o braço da casa de teu pai, de sorte que não haja ancião em tua casa.

verses.original: וְהִבַּטְתָּ֙ צַ֣ר מָע֔וֹן בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵיטִ֖יב אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה זָקֵ֛ן בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hib·baṭ·tā ṣar mā·‘ō·wn bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yê·ṭîḇ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- yih·yeh zā·qên bə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: You will see distress in My dwelling place Despite all that is good in Israel no one in your house will ever again reach old age
verses.literalPt: Em todo o bem que Deus fará a Israel verás o aperto na minha habitação; e nunca haverá um ancião em tua casa.

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ לֹֽא־ אַכְרִ֤ית לְךָ֙ מֵעִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔י לְכַלּ֥וֹת אֶת־ עֵינֶ֖יךָ וְלַאֲדִ֣יב אֶת־ נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְכָל־ מַרְבִּ֥ית בֵּיתְךָ֖ יָמ֥וּתוּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš lō- ’aḵ·rîṯ lə·ḵā mê·‘im miz·bə·ḥî lə·ḵal·lō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ne·ḵā wə·la·’ă·ḏîḇ ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā wə·ḵāl mar·bîṯ bê·ṯə·ḵā yā·mū·ṯū ’ă·nā·šîm
verses.literal: And every one of you that I do not cut off from My altar I will cause your eyes to fail - and your heart to grieve All your descendants . . . will die by the sword of men
verses.literalPt: O homem da tua linhagem a quem eu não cortar do meu altar será poupado para que os teus olhos se consumam, e a tua alma se entristeça; todos os descendentes da tua casa morrerão na flor da idade.

verses.original: וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֣ הָא֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ אֶל־ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָ֑ס בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד יָמ֥וּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh- lə·ḵā hā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·šer yā·ḇō ’el- šə·nê ḇā·ne·ḵā ’el- ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ yā·mū·ṯū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: And this sign shall come to you concerning your two sons . . . Hophni and Phinehas They will both die on the same day
verses.literalPt: Será para ti por sinal o que sobrevirá a teus dois filhos, a Hofni e a Fineias: no mesmo dia morrerão ambos.

verses.original: וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י לִי֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן נֶאֱמָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּלְבָבִ֥י וּבְנַפְשִׁ֖י יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּבָנִ֤יתִי לוֹ֙ בַּ֣יִת נֶאֱמָ֔ן וְהִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי־ מְשִׁיחִ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qî·mō·ṯî lî kō·hên ne·’ĕ·mān ka·’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇî ū·ḇə·nap̄·šî ya·‘ă·śeh ū·ḇā·nî·ṯî lōw ba·yiṯ ne·’ĕ·mān wə·hiṯ·hal·lēḵ lip̄·nê- mə·šî·ḥî kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest He will do whatever is in My heart and mind And I will build for him an enduring house and he will walk before My anointed one for all time . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu suscitarei para mim um sacerdote fiel, que fará segundo tudo o que está no meu coração e na minha mente; edificar-lhe-ei uma casa duradoura, e ele andará sempre diante do meu ungido.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כָּל־ הַנּוֹתָר֙ בְּבֵ֣יתְךָ֔ יָבוֹא֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת ל֔וֹ לַאֲג֥וֹרַת כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּר־ לָ֑חֶם וְאָמַ֗ר סְפָחֵ֥נִי נָ֛א אֶל־ אַחַ֥ת הַכְּהֻנּ֖וֹת לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פַּת־ לָֽחֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kāl- han·nō·w·ṯār bə·ḇê·ṯə·ḵā yā·ḇō·w lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ lōw la·’ă·ḡō·w·raṯ ke·sep̄ wə·ḵik·kar- lā·ḥem wə·’ā·mar sə·p̄ā·ḥê·nî nā ’el- ’a·ḥaṯ hak·kə·hun·nō·wṯ le·’ĕ·ḵōl paṯ- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: And everyone left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver or a morsel of bread pleading Please appoint me to some priestly office so that I can eat a piece of bread
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que restar em tua casa virá e se prostrará diante dele por uma moeda de prata e por um pão e dirá: Rogo-te que me admitas a um dos cargos sacerdotais, para que eu coma um bocado de pão.
